zh.title: Hermès — 季节橱窗世界
zh.summary: 通过商品、道具、材质与光线的关系，参与构建三个季节的橱窗叙事。
zh.role: BENWU 团队 · 三维设计与视觉呈现
zh.problem: 如何让季节主题形成鲜明的空间体验，同时让商品成为画面的主角？
zh.outcome: 项目档案保留了夏、秋、冬三季的空间与视觉方案，以及季节语言的对照。我的工作集中在团队中的三维设计和视觉呈现。
zh.reflection: 季节差异不只来自颜色和装饰。真正需要比较的是观看距离、商品层级、道具比例以及材料对光线的反应。
decisions: 夏季：图形成为空间节奏
以图形、色块和重复关系建立活力，同时比较商品与背景的对比，避免主题吞没陈列。
秋季：熟悉物件形成超现实关系
利用家具、物件与尺度变化组织场景，让观者在熟悉与陌生之间建立叙事联想。
冬季：马术意象与冰雪层次
通过白马、雪地层面和悬挂关系，比较主体、商品与背景的距离及层次。

en.title: Hermès — Seasonal Window Worlds
en.summary: Contributing to three seasonal window narratives through merchandise, props, material and light.
en.problem: How can each season create a distinct spatial world while keeping merchandise at the centre of the composition?
en.outcome: The project record retains summer, autumn and winter spatial and visual studies. My contribution focused on 3D design and visual presentation within the BENWU team.
en.reflection: Seasonal distinction involves more than colour and decoration. Viewing distance, merchandise hierarchy, prop proportion and the response of materials to light are the useful comparisons.
decisions: Summer: graphic energy in space
Graphic shapes, colour blocks and repetition establish rhythm. Product-to-background contrast keeps the merchandise legible.
Autumn: a surreal domestic world
Familiar furniture and objects become narrative elements through shifts in scale and unexpected spatial relationships.
Winter: an equestrian frozen landscape
The horse, snow planes and suspended accessories establish a hierarchy of figure, merchandise and background.

zh.title: Arc’teryx — 山地性能场
zh.summary: 将地形、身体与装备转译为空间层次，参与 Alpha Center 橱窗的三维设计与视觉表达。
zh.role: BENWU 团队 · 三维设计与空间视觉
zh.problem: 如何让户外性能的语境进入零售空间，同时清楚呈现身体、装备与环境的关系？
zh.outcome: 形成地形、方向与装备层级的空间表达；公开档案包含方案图与补充落地效果图。
zh.reflection: 技术叙事需要让关系可读：哪里承载、力量如何指向、装备如何被观看。视觉上的动态不能替代性能或工程验证。
decisions: 从地形建立层次
以地形的高差、折线与体块建立观看顺序，让商品有清晰的位置，而非仅作为场景装饰。
用方向组织力量感
比较斜向、路径和视觉重心，使空间中的运动线索服务身体与装备之间的关系。
回到展示尺度
通过全景与局部视图比较支撑、悬挂、商品间距及观看角度，并以落地效果图补充空间阅读。

en.title: Arc’teryx — Mountain Performance Field
en.summary: Translating terrain, bodies and equipment into spatial layers for the Alpha Center window display.
en.problem: How can an outdoor performance context become a retail environment in which the relationship between body, equipment and terrain remains clear?
en.outcome: The archive presents spatial studies of terrain, direction and equipment hierarchy, alongside additional installation views.
en.reflection: A technical narrative needs readable relationships: support, direction and viewing position. Visual dynamism alone does not establish performance or engineering validation.
decisions: Start with terrain
Changes in height, angular lines and volumes establish a viewing sequence and give merchandise a clear place.
Organise direction and force
Diagonals, paths and visual centres connect spatial motion cues to the relationship between bodies and equipment.
Return to display scale
Overall and detail views compare support, suspension, spacing and viewing angles. Installation views add spatial context.

zh.title: Karimoku × BENWU — 设计研究
zh.summary: 从木作文化、材料与留白出发，研究家具如何进入空间、摄影与传播。
zh.role: 品牌与材料研究 · 空间叙事整理
zh.problem: 如何将木作家具的文化基础转化为材料、空间和观看路径之间的关系？
zh.outcome: 整理了品牌基础、文化转译、材料、留白、动线、光线与传播的连续研究框架，公开阶段为 Design Study。
zh.reflection: 克制需要具体依据：物件之间的距离、层次、材料边缘和光线变化。研究仍需材料样片与原始项目记录支持后续判断。
decisions: 从文化语义转向材料关系
以木材、工艺与生活方式为研究起点，比较边界、连接和触感，避免把文化简化为装饰符号。
用空与层组织观看
家具、墙面和展示物之间的间距承担空间秩序；全景与局部共同解释比例。
让光线连接时间与传播
关注阴影、表面变化和摄影尺度，让传播画面保留材料与空间的关系。

en.title: Karimoku × BENWU — Design Study
en.summary: A study of how woodcraft, material and space can connect furniture, photography and communication.
en.problem: How can a furniture brand’s craft and cultural context translate into relationships between materials, space and movement?
en.outcome: A connected research framework spanning brand foundations, cultural translation, materials, void, movement, light and communication. Presented as a design study.
en.reflection: Restraint needs concrete decisions about distance, layers, edges and light. Material samples and original project records remain necessary for further validation.
decisions: Translate culture into relationships
Wood, craft and everyday life inform the study of edges, joints and touch, beyond decorative shorthand.
Organise the void and the layers
Distances between furniture, walls and display elements create spatial order. Overall and detail views explain scale together.
Connect light and communication
Shadows, surface variation and photographic scale help preserve material and spatial relationships in communication.

zh.title: 铝型材灯具系统
zh.summary: 一个截面、不同的使用位置：连接台灯、落地灯、壁灯与吊灯的系列语言。
zh.role: BENWU 团队 · 三维设计与视觉呈现
zh.problem: 长度、方向和支撑方式改变时，哪些形态特征可以维持系列的一致性？
zh.outcome: 通过单体、细部与室内场景呈现系列关系，支持造型、材料与比例的比较。
zh.reflection: 视觉上的一致性不等于工程部件通用。进一步开发需要结合光学、散热、装配与控制方式验证。
decisions: 截面建立家族特征
近似四瓣的端部轮廓和纵向发光条构成可识别的共同语言，变化集中在长度、方向和支撑。
细部解释材料与功能
金属槽道、发光面和圆形控制件分别承担结构、光线与交互的视觉线索。
场景校准比例
以桌面、墙面与长桌为参照，比较同一种线性语言如何适应不同使用位置。

en.title: Aluminum Lighting System
en.summary: One section across different uses: a family of table, floor, wall and pendant lights.
en.problem: As length, direction and support change, which formal characteristics hold a product family together?
en.outcome: Object, detail and interior views make the family’s formal, material and proportional relationships available for comparison.
en.reflection: Visual consistency does not establish shared engineering components. Further development requires optical, thermal, assembly and control validation.
decisions: Build identity through the section
A near four-lobed end profile and longitudinal light strip create common features, while length, orientation and support vary.
Explain material and function in the detail
Metal channels, luminous surfaces and circular controls provide distinct visual cues for construction, light and interaction.
Calibrate proportion in context
Desks, walls and long tables provide references for comparing how one linear language adapts to different uses.

zh.title: 夜礼司 — 品牌、产品与 CMF
zh.summary: 从中文识别到产品概念，让边界、曲线与触感形成连续的品牌语言。
zh.role: 团队协作 · 品牌视觉、产品概念与 CMF
zh.problem: 如何同时表达亲密感、仪式感和个人边界，并让品牌识别与产品概念相互支撑？
zh.outcome: 形成以中文名称与私印秩序为核心的品牌方向，并延伸出产品和 CMF 概念。产品尚处概念阶段。
zh.reflection: 材料与接触方式应经过实物验证。磁吸、释放、耐久与人体工学是后续研究重点，不能由渲染图直接推断。
decisions: 将中文名称变成品牌资产
从早期 Songnasty 的曲线探索转向中文字标与私印秩序，让名称成为稳定的识别核心。
用边界容纳流动
近方形轮廓和篆意笔画提供秩序，身体曲线作为负形进入第二层阅读。
将识别延伸至物件
蛇形主体与蝴蝶配件探索连接、组合与触感，将品牌语义转成产品和 CMF 的具体研究问题。

en.title: YELISI — Brand, Product & CMF
en.summary: Connecting a Chinese identity to product concepts through boundaries, curves and touch.
en.role: Team collaboration · Identity, product concepts & CMF
en.problem: How can intimacy, ritual and personal boundaries inform both a recognisable identity and a coherent product direction?
en.outcome: An identity direction centred on the Chinese name and seal-like order, extended into product and CMF studies. The products remain concepts.
en.reflection: Materials and contact mechanisms need physical validation. Magnetic retention, release, durability and ergonomics cannot be established by renders.
decisions: Make the name a brand asset
The work moved from early Songnasty curves to Chinese lettering and seal-like order, giving the identity a stable centre.
Hold fluidity within a boundary
A near-square contour and seal-inspired strokes establish order; bodily curves emerge as a secondary reading in negative space.
Extend identity into objects
A snake-like body and butterfly components explore connection, combination and touch, translating brand semantics into product and CMF questions.

zh.title: Periastra — 品牌策略与系统
zh.summary: 以摄影装备为语境，连接品牌定位、字体识别、信息层级和产品语言。
zh.role: 团队协作 · 品牌图形、应用与信息系统
zh.problem: 如何建立具有技术感的品牌识别，同时让产品与应用信息保持清楚？
zh.outcome: 形成从品牌定位、字标到应用和信息系统的研究方向；以摄影装备的阅读需求组织视觉层级。
zh.reflection: 对经典品牌的研究应提取方法。Hasselblad 在此作为 Reference Study，其品牌资产和产品不属于本项目成果。
decisions: 先建立定位和阅读顺序
围绕摄影装备的使用与信息需求，区分品牌识别、产品信息和辅助叙述的职责。
用字标建立稳定识别
比较字形结构、笔画、负形与间距，使技术语气与可读性保持平衡。
把图形转成系统规则
在不同应用尺度中检查信息层级与产品语言，使品牌表达可以延续。

en.title: Periastra — Brand Strategy & System
en.summary: Connecting positioning, typographic identity, information hierarchy and product language for a photography-equipment context.
en.role: Team collaboration · Identity, applications & information systems
en.problem: How can a technically expressive identity keep product and application information clear?
en.outcome: A study connecting positioning and lettering to applications and information systems, organised around how photography equipment is read and used.
en.reflection: Studying an established brand means learning its methods. Hasselblad is a reference study here; its brand assets and products are not project outcomes.
decisions: Define positioning and reading order
Separate the roles of brand identity, product information and supporting communication around the needs of photography equipment.
Create stability through lettering
Compare letter structure, strokes, negative space and spacing to balance technical character with legibility.
Turn graphics into rules
Test hierarchy and product language at different application scales so that the identity remains coherent.

zh.title: 彼源 AI — 品牌与产品体验
zh.summary: 让多模型服务拥有统一识别、清楚的信息层级和可以继续的操作路径。
zh.role: 整体 VI/UI 设计与体验迭代
zh.problem: 如何把不同模型和服务组织成用户能够理解、选择并继续使用的体验？
zh.outcome: 完成品牌视觉与桌面、移动界面的设计和迭代表达；公开项目按产品协作与原型边界呈现。
zh.reflection: 一致的视觉需要与任务逻辑一起工作。模型选择、反馈和下一步操作应共同降低理解成本，具体效果仍需真实使用研究。
decisions: 先建立一致的入口
让标识、页面层级和关键操作采用一致的视觉语气，帮助用户识别服务。
把模型信息变成可比较的选择
区分主要任务、模型信息和操作状态，避免把所有内容放在同一层级。
让跨屏体验延续
在桌面与移动端保留共同的信息顺序，再根据屏幕和操作方式调整密度。

en.title: Biyuan AI — Identity & Product Experience
en.summary: A shared identity, clear information hierarchy and continuous task paths for a multi-model service.
en.role: Visual identity, UI design & experience iteration
en.problem: How can multiple models and services become an experience people can understand, choose from and continue using?
en.outcome: Visual identity and desktop/mobile interface design and iteration, presented within the boundaries of product collaboration and prototyping.
en.reflection: Visual consistency must work with task logic. Model selection, feedback and next actions should reduce the effort of understanding; effects require actual user research.
decisions: Create a consistent entry point
Align identity, page hierarchy and key actions so users can recognise the service across screens.
Make model information comparable
Distinguish the main task, model information and operating state instead of treating all content equally.
Carry the experience across screens
Keep a shared reading order on desktop and mobile, then adjust density for screen size and interaction.
